Wie viele Sitzungen sind für die Laser-H: How many sessions are needed for laser hair removal?
Die Anzahl der Sitzungen für die Laser-H: The number of sessions depends on several factors, including the body area being treated, hair colour and type, skin type and individual physical characteristics.
Die ersten Sitzungen finden im Abstand v: The first sessions take place 4 weeks apart. After that the intervals are extended to 6–8 weeks, as hair growth slows down.
Der Laser wirkt nur auf Haare, die sich: The laser only works on hair in the active growth phase (anagen phase), not on resting hair. As not all hair grows at the same time, several sessions are needed to treat all hair follicles.
Wie bereite ich mich auf diese Behandlun: How do I prepare for the treatment?
1. Keine Sonnenbäder nehmen (auch kein S: 1. No sunbathing (including solarium) for 2 weeks before the treatment. A tan increases the risk of burns and reduces the effectiveness of the laser.
2. Keine Haarentfernung mit Wurzel (z. B: 2. No hair removal from the root (e.g. waxing, sugaring) for 3–4 weeks before the treatment. Shaving only.
3. Keine aggressiven Peelings oder Scrub: 3. Do not use aggressive peels or scrubs on the area to be treated for 3–5 days before the session.
4. 6-12 Stunden vor dem Eingriff muss de: 4. Shave the treatment area thoroughly 6–12 hours before the procedure. Waxing is strictly prohibited for 4 weeks before the procedure. Do not apply any cream or deodorant before the procedure and do not take antibiotics.
5. Keine Antibiotika aus der Gruppe der: 5. Do not take antibiotics from the tetracycline or fluoroquinolone groups for 2 weeks before the treatment, as they make the skin more sensitive to the laser.
Diese Regeln helfen, das Risiko von Nebe: These rules help to minimise the risk of side effects and maximise the effectiveness of the treatment.

Ist eine Laser-Haarentfernung während de: Is laser hair removal possible during pregnancy or breastfeeding?
Laser-Haarentfernung wird während der Sc: Laser hair removal is not recommended during pregnancy and breastfeeding. Although there is no scientific evidence that it harms the unborn child or the baby, skin sensitivity may be increased during this time, making the treatment less comfortable and effective. Kann die Laser-Haarentfernung auch bei h: Can laser hair removal be done on light or red hair?
Eine Laserhaarentfernung ist bei weissen: Laser hair removal is not possible on white, red or grey hair, because the laser targets melanin, the pigment contained in the hair. Melanin absorbs the light energy of the laser, converts it into heat and thus destroys the hair follicle, preventing further hair growth.
1. Weisse und graue Haare enthalten kaum: 1. White and grey hair contain hardly any melanin. Without pigment the laser has no "target" to act on, so the treatment is ineffective.
2. Rote Haare enthalten eine andere Art: 2. Red hair contains a different type of melanin – pheomelanin, which absorbs light less well. This significantly reduces the effect of the laser, and the follicles remain undamaged.
Wie funktioniert ein Diodenlaser?: How does a diode laser work?
Die Lichtenergie des Diodenlasers dringt: The light energy of the diode laser penetrates the skin and is absorbed by the melanin in the hair shaft and hair root.
Die absorbierte Energie wird in Wärme um: The absorbed energy is converted into heat, heating the hair follicle to about 70–80°C. This leads to coagulation (destruction) of the cells responsible for hair growth.
Die Laserenergie wirkt ausschliesslich a: The laser energy acts exclusively on the hair pigment while sparing the surrounding skin, which reduces the risk of burns and irritation.
Die Zerstörung des Haarfollikels führt d: The destruction of the hair follicle causes the hair to fall out gradually. With repeated treatments (usually 6–8 sessions) active hair follicles are completely destroyed, so hair growth is greatly reduced or stopped.
Die Laserhaarentfernung ist bei fachgere: When performed correctly by trained staff with high-quality equipment, laser hair removal is not harmful to health. The procedure acts exclusively on the melanin in the hair and destroys the hair follicle without damaging the skin or internal organs.
Warum ist die Laserhaarentfernung sicher: Why is laser hair removal safe?
Der Laserstrahl dringt nur in die oberen: The laser beam only penetrates the upper layers of the skin (2–4 mm deep), where the hair follicles are located. Internal organs and deeper tissue are not reached.
Die Geräte sind mit Kühlsystemen und anp: The devices have cooling systems and adjustable energy settings, which minimise the risk of burns and increase comfort during the treatment.
Der Laser gibt ausschliesslich Lichtener: The laser emits only light energy, which has nothing to do with ionising radiation (such as X-rays).
Der Laserimpuls wirkt nur wenige Millise: The laser pulse lasts only a few milliseconds – long enough to destroy the hair follicle, but too short to damage surrounding tissue.
